text: Given a valid computerId and valid ImmyBot credentials, When immybot_computers_set_needs_onboarding(computerId=7) is called, Then the result is {"done": true, "computer_id": 7, ...} and ImmyBot received POST computers/7/set-to-needs-onboarding.

Given ImmyBot returns a 404 for computerId=999, When immybot_computers_set_needs_onboarding is called with that id, Then the result is {"error": {"code": "invalid_argument", "retryable": false, ...}}.

Given no ImmyBot credential headers are present on the request, When immybot_computers_set_needs_onboarding is called, Then the result is the standard not_configured error envelope and no HTTP call reaches ImmyBot.
notes: Generic, already-existing test exercises run_tool's shared not_configured path; this tool adds no new credential-handling code, so no per-tool duplicate is added.

text: Given a tools/list request against the deployed server, Then immybot_computers_set_needs_onboarding is listed with exactly one required parameter computerId (type number), a write annotation (readOnlyHint=false), and is reachable from immybot_navigate("computers").
notes: These are existing parametrized/generic tests; they validate the new tool automatically once it is added to EXPECTED_TOOLS/WRITE_TOOLS and to navigation.py's DOMAINS["computers"] list.

text: Given a real ImmyBot test tenant and a computer not currently flagged for onboarding, When immybot_computers_set_needs_onboarding is called against the live API and then immybot_computers_get is called for the same computer, Then the computer's onboarding status reflects the change, and starting maintenance for that computer begins the onboarding flow.
steps: Obtain ImmyBot credentials for a real test tenant and pick a known computerId not flagged for onboarding
Call immybot_computers_get(computerId) and inspect the onboarding status field
Call immybot_maintenance_sessions_start for the same computer and observe whether onboarding maintenance begins
expect: Onboarding status reflects the change after step 2; maintenance started in step 4 runs as an onboarding session
evidence: needs a real vendor account — no ImmyBot test tenant available in the design leg; see global vendor-mcp rule, missing test account does not block the design or dev legs

text: Given two different ImmyBot credential sets, When each is used to call a tool, Then they never share a cached token or client instance — this tool introduces no new credential-handling code, so it inherits the connector's existing per-request isolation guarantee unchanged.
notes: Existing, generic test at the ImmyBotClient layer; this new tool only calls client.post(), the same call every other write tool makes, so no new isolation test is needed.
